title: EIP-3298: Remove storage-clear refund and refund cap
description: Removes the SSTORE storage-clearing refund and the transaction refund cap, leaving only net-metered same-transaction write reversals
author: Vitalik Buterin (@vbuterin), Martin Swende (@holiman), Jochem Brouwer (@jochem-brouwer)
laymanDescription: Clearing a storage slot or destroying a contract earns gas back, a discount meant to encourage tidying up after yourself. It never worked, and it is instead used to stockpile cheap gas for later. This proposal removes the discount entirely.
benefits: Kills GasToken, which fills state with junk slots purely to bank cheap gas
A block can no longer consume nearly twice its stated gas limit
Removes the refund counter from storage accounting rather than partly retaining it
tradeoffs: Clearing storage becomes strictly a cost, removing any incentive to tidy up state
Arbitrage bots relying on gas storage schemes must be rewritten to stay economical
State growth is left entirely to a future statelessness or state expiry solution
